rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact A-grade ICM, and looser B-grade TE consistent with 3AB; notes limits of a single static image. Minor overinterpretation of darker/granular area and slight uncertainty about exact grading prevent a perfect score.

Integrates age, DOR, prior miscarriage, thin endometrium, BMI, ovarian response, semen parameters, and lifestyle factors well, and explains how these modify prognosis despite decent embryo morphology.

Final answer is structured and mostly logical, but the overall response contains internal inconsistency around implantation/live birth estimates and some tension between calling the embryo good quality while suggesting lower probabilities than some cited benchmarks.

Generally aligns with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, caution with 6 mm lining, avoid routine add-ons, consider uterine evaluation and PGT-A discussion. Minor deviations include some imprecise statements about grading terminology and speculative protocol/add-on comments.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including luteal optimization, uterine cavity assessment, alcohol cessation, and protocol review. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
